title: CF-LoRA: Decoupled Factor Aggregation and Adaptation-Aware Client Clustering for Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36986v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated LoRA fine-tuning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of pre-trained models without sharing private data, but suffers from two fundamental mismatches under heterogeneous client data: a structural aggregation mismatch caused by independently averaging LoRA factors, and a statistical collaboration mismatch caused by enforcing a single global adapter across divergent clients. To address these issues, we propose CF-LoRA, a clustered federated LoRA fine-tuning framework that combines decoupled factor aggregation with adaptation-aware client clustering. CF-LoRA first learns a globally shared $A$ factor while retaining personalized $B_i$ factors, then identifies clients with similar adaptation patterns based on the cosine similarity of their learned $B_i$ factors, and finally performs intra-cluster $B$-factor aggregation with a frozen $A$ factor. translated_title: CF-LoRA：面向联邦LoRA微调的解耦因子聚合与自适应感知客户端聚类
translated_abstract: 联邦LoRA微调能够在不共享私有数据的前提下对预训练模型进行参数高效的适配，但在客户端数据异构的场景下面临两个根本性的不匹配问题：一是由独立平均LoRA因子导致的结构聚合不匹配，二是在差异较大的客户端之间强制使用单一全局适配器导致的统计协作不匹配。为解决这些问题，我们提出了CF-LoRA，这是一个将解耦因子聚合与自适应感知客户端聚类相结合的聚类联邦LoRA微调框架。CF-LoRA首先在保留个性化 $B_i$ 因子的同时学习全局共享的 $A$ 因子，然后基于学习到的 $B_i$ 因子的余弦相似度识别具有相似适配模式的客户端，最后在冻结 $A$ 因子的条件下执行簇内 $B$ 因子聚合。通过解耦LoRA因子聚合，CF-LoRA保持了低秩结构并减轻（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: CF-LoRA提出了一种聚类联邦LoRA微调框架，通过解耦A/B因子的聚合方式，并基于B因子的余弦相似度进行自适应感知的客户端聚类，有效解决了异构客户端数据下联邦LoRA微调中的结构聚合不匹配与统计协作不匹配两大问题。
en_tdlr: CF-LoRA proposes a clustered federated LoRA fine-tuning framework that decouples A/B factor aggregation and performs adaptation-aware client clustering based on B-factor cosine similarity, addressing the structural aggregation and statistical collaboration mismatches under heterogeneous client data.
